entities.name: Negotiated WUS assistance information IE
entities.description: Information element containing negotiated Wake-Up Signal assistance information parameters between UE and network.

entities.name: UE supports WUS assistance information
entities.description: Condition that the UE has capability to support Wake-Up Signal assistance information.

entities.name: AMF supports and accepts WUS assistance information
entities.description: Condition that the AMF both supports and accepts the use of Wake-Up Signal assistance information.

entities.name: UE not performing initial registration for emergency services
entities.description: Condition that the UE is not performing the initial registration procedure specifically for emergency services.

entities.name: UE has no active emergency PDU session
entities.description: Condition that the UE does not currently have an active emergency PDU session established.

entities.name: Network includes Negotiated WUS assistance information IE
entities.description: Network behavior to include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE in relevant messages when all conditions are met.

relations.description: Network behavior establishes the inclusion of the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE.
Network inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that UE supports WUS assistance information.
Network inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that AMF supports and accepts WUS assistance information.
Network inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that UE is not performing initial registration for emergency services.
Network inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that UE has no active emergency PDU session.
